name: The Ad Department · 02 · At sixty miles an hour
description:
"At sixty miles an hour the loudest noise in this picture comes from the concrete." The car is the quiet part.

Magazine ad 2 of 6 from the El Segundo Auto Repair campaign, a brutalist motor art project by Mike Hoydich. Written and set by Claude in the motor art repo. Nouns and glasses from the official CC0 Nouns traits. Free edition. A keepsake. No coin, no promise. Published by officenoun.tez.
rights: Nouns art CC0. Ad copy, layout and photograph by Mike Hoydich's studio.
